reviews.comment: Worst undergrad experience to date, class is graded off of 4 things, grading criteria makes no sense and is way too specific for how little time is given on the quizzes, not to mention there was very little practice material (solutions are only posted with answers and no steps) and absolutely none for one of the questions on the final

The grade is entirely determined by 3 “quizzes” worth 22% each and a final. The quizzes are almost impossible to finish in time, questions are shown no point values and he released quiz 1 grades after taking quiz 2. Overall, far harder than necessary to do well in, you can understand everything and still do poorly. Teaches well, but is very harsh
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Jackson is an amazing professor. He explains concepts very well and makes sure lectures are interesting. You can tell he cares about his students, so I would 100% recommend taking him if you get the chance.

Lectures were very easy to follow and were actually enjoyable to attend, homework makes up a large portion of your grade but the lowest is dropped. The class follows very closely with the textbook. Only issue is exams were terrible with averages in the 50's, however, these were always curved fairly (approx 25 pts).
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He's a great guy and teacher who conveys and teaches the material well and follows the book closely, hw is also 50% which is good and he drops the lowest one. The book's very helpful as well so definetly read it. The only issue is his exams were not made by him for the most part but by the other proffessor so the averages were very low and curved.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr Jackson is a great guy and engaging lecturer. He does his best to give you opportunities to succeed in the class. Homework is 50% with a midterm and final making up the other half. He follows allow closely with Anderson's Fundamentals of Aerodynamics
